user.title: Kitchen Planner
user.description: Links your Mealie dinner plan to the planner data so Home Assistant can build the Coles order.

data_description.mealie_entry_id: The Mealie instance whose dinner plan drives the shopping list.
data_description.serves: Household serving size. Recipes are scaled to this.
data_description.horizon_days: Days of staples cover to buy ahead of the Sunday pickup.
data_description.data_dir: Folder under /config holding recipes.json, pack-catalogue.json, mealie-map.json and the other planner files.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read the Mealie dinner plan and rebuild the shopping list now.

import_file.name: Import data file
import_file.description: Replace one planner data file in the data folder. The previous version is kept as a .bak file.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Which planner data file to write.

data.name: Data
data.description: The file's JSON, gzip-compressed then base64-encoded.

set_on_hand.name: Set on hand
set_on_hand.description: Record that an item is already in the house, so this week's list buys less of it. Expires at the end of the planning week unless 'until' is given.

packs.name: Packs
packs.description: How many of the smallest catalogue pack you have. Used when qty is not given.

until.name: Until
until.description: Last day this counts; defaults to the end of the planning week.

clear_on_hand.name: Clear on hand
clear_on_hand.description: Remove an item from what's in the house.
